burrata.name: Burrata & inyanya
burrata.description: Umupira woroshye wa burrata nshya, inyanya nziza zo mu bwoko bwa tomato na basile, urangije amavuta ya elayo. Kuzuza hamwe na sourdough ishyushye.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (amata), inyanya, ibase, amavuta ya elayo, sourdough (ingano), umunyu winyanja.

dumplings.name: Amashanyarazi ya Chili-crisp
dumplings.short: Amababi y'imboga ya zahabu, amavuta ya chili, scolions.
dumplings.description: Amababi atandatu ashakishwa nimboga hamwe nimbuto yoroshye hamwe na centre yoroshye. Byarangiye hamwe namavuta ya chili na scallions, hamwe na soya yogeje soya kuruhande.
dumplings.ingredients: Gupfunyika ingano, imyumbati, ibihumyo, karoti, inkeri, isosi ya soya (soya, ingano), sesame, amavuta ya chili.

pasta.name: Inyanya & basil rigatoni
pasta.short: Buhoro buhoro inyanya zokeje, ibase rishya, parmesan.
pasta.description: Ipasitori ikaranze yajugunywe mu isosi y'inyanya ikungahaye, itetse buhoro, hamwe na basile nshya na parmesan y'ibimera. Ihumure, yoroshye, kandi ikozwe mugihe kirekire cya sasita.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (ingano), inyanya, ibase, parmesan y'ibimera (amata), amavuta ya elayo, tungurusumu.

salad.name: Igikombe gikaranze
salad.description: Beterave ikaranze hamwe nibijumba hejuru yicyatsi kibisi, hamwe na soya, citrusi nziza nibimera bishya. Kwambara indimu byose hamwe.
salad.ingredients: Beterave, ibijumba, ibishyimbo, citrusi, icyatsi, peteroli, mint, sesame, indimu, amavuta ya elayo.

chicken.name: Indimu & ibyatsi
chicken.short: Inkoko ya zahabu, ibirayi byabana, ibishyimbo kibisi.
chicken.description: Inkoko ikaranze ibyatsi hamwe nuruhu rworoshye, ibirayi byabana nibishyimbo kibisi. Bikorewe hamwe n'indimu yoroheje hamwe namavuta ya elayo.
chicken.ingredients: Inkoko, ibirayi, ibishyimbo kibisi, indimu, amavuta ya elayo, rozemari, thime, tungurusumu.

cake.name: Shokora ganache cake
cake.short: Shokora yijimye, cream ya vanilla, raspberry nshya.
cake.description: Igice gikungahaye kuri shokora ya cake hamwe na shokora yijimye yijimye. Amavuta make ya vanilla hamwe na raspberry nshya kuruhande.
cake.ingredients: Shokora, ifu y'ingano, amagi, amavuta (amata), cream (amata), isukari, vanilla, raspberry.

lemonade.name: Strawberry basil indimu
lemonade.short: Strawberry nziza, indimu, ibase & amazi meza.
lemonade.description: Indimu yaka cyane, yaka cyane hamwe na strawberry nshya, kunyunyuza indimu na basile nziza. Bikorewe hejuru yurubura.
lemonade.ingredients: Strawberry, indimu, ibase, isukari y'ibisheke, amazi meza, urubura.

tea.name: Jasmine icyayi
tea.short: Icyayi cya jasimine icyayi, indimu, urubura rwinshi.
tea.description: Icyayi gishya cya jasimine, gikonje kandi kigatanga hejuru yurubura hamwe n'indimu. Ntabwo biryoshye, hamwe nindabyo nziza zirangije.
tea.ingredients: Icyayi cya Jasmine, indimu, amazi yungurujwe, urubura. Harimo cafeyine.
